name: MonarchIconButton
title: Icon button
summary: A square button that shows only an icon; the label is its TalkBack name.
whenToUse: For a toolbar or row action that an icon says well: close, more actions, refresh.
whenNotToUse: When the action needs a word to be understood use MonarchButton with an icon.
api: @Composable fun MonarchIconButton(label: String, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchButtonVariant = MonarchButtonVariant.Ghost, size: MonarchButtonSize = MonarchButtonSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, loading: Boolean = false, loadingLabel: String? = null, shape: Shape? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null, icon: @Composable () -> Unit)

options.name: label
options.description: What the button does. It is the TalkBack name; an icon-only button is never unnamed.

options.name: onClick
options.description: Runs when activated, unless loading or disabled.

options.name: variant
options.description: The visual weight; the variants of MonarchButton.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm 32dp, Md 36dp or Lg 40dp square; the touch target is 48dp.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the user can activate the button.

options.name: loading
options.description: A spinner replaces the icon and taps are ignored; the size does not change.

options.name: shape
options.description: The outline and focus ring; null uses the medium Monarch shape.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: To observe or drive press and focus.

options.name: icon
options.description: The icon, for example a MonarchIcon with a null content description.

states.name: resting
states.description: The fill, border and label color of the variant; primary, secondary, danger, success and warning have the xs shadow.

states.name: hovered
states.description: The hover fill of the variant (accent, danger, success or warning solid hover; muted for neutral buttons).

states.name: pressed
states.description: The pressed fill of the variant and the ripple in the label color.

states.name: focused
states.description: The Monarch focus ring, 2dp, with a 2dp gap, around the visible button.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The variant at half opacity, like the web; announced as disabled.

states.name: loading
states.description: A spinner takes the place of the leading icon, or is drawn over the label when there is no icon; the button keeps its size; taps are ignored; the state is announced.

appearance: Primary is filled with the accent, danger with the danger color, success and warning with their solid roles, in every theme. Secondary is a bordered surface, ghost has no fill, danger-subtle is the tinted danger fill with a danger border, link is the link color with an underline. In the high-contrast themes the same roles resolve to stronger colors.
platformNotes: The square of the web's icon button: 32, 36 or 40dp visible with a 48dp touch target reserved around it. It replaces the Material 3 IconButton, which has no variants and a 40dp state layer.
accessibility: Has the button role and the label as its name; the icon is decoration.
The touch target is at least 48dp by 48dp and reserves that space.
While loading it keeps its name and focus place, ignores taps and announces Loading.
A disabled button is announced as disabled.
edgeCases: Pass a null content description to the icon; the label already names the button.
